The '''Noquivzor base recreation center''' was a recreation center in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] base on [[Noquivzor]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]]. [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]] once bought [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] a mug of [[Lum/Legends|lum]] in the center.
